title: 21-Day Dry Cargo Time Charter
agency_path: DEPT OF DEFENSE.DEPT OF THE NAVY.MSC.MSC HQS.MSCHQ NORFOLK
detail_text: Action Code: Pre-solicitation Date: 29 April 2026 Year: Fiscal Year 2026 Contracting Office Zip Code: 23511 Product or Service Code: V124- Transportation, Travel, & Relocation Services Contracting Office Address: 471 East C Street, Naval Station Norfolk, Norfolk, VA 23511 Subject: 21-day Dry Cargo Time Charter Proposed Solicitation Number: N3220526R6080 Closing Response Date: Monday, 04 May 2026 Contract Point of Contact or Contract Specialist: Jordan Morrison at jordan.a.morrison5.civ@us.navy.mil and Brandon Page at brandon.a.page.civ@us.navy.mil Contract Award and Solicitation Number: TBD Contract Award Dollar Amount: TBD Contract Line Item Number: N/A Contract Award Date: TBA Contractor: TBD Description: This requirement requires U.S. or foreign flag, self-sustaining Roll-on/Roll-off vessel(s) (multiple awards up to four vessels or until the needs of the government have been met), capable of carrying a minimum of 110,000 SQFT of military cargo (wheeled vehicles, tracked vehicles, and breakbulk) out of a total 426,530 SQFT. Minimum laden speed shall be 15 knots. Place of Contract Performance: The place/range of delivery is Bremerhaven, Germany; and the place/range of redelivery is Corpus Christi, Texas (USA). The layday(s) commences and cancels on 22 June 2026, 26 June 2026, 30 June 2026, and 04 July 2026. Owners/Offerors to indicate estimated time of arrival (ETA) for each layday commencing/cancelling date. Owners/Offerors shall also indicate any layday window they do not want to consider. The period of performance will be about 21 days for each chartered vessel. Set-aside Status: N/A. The decision to release this procurement as “Unrestricted” is based on responses received from a recent, sources sought notice for this service. All responsible sources may submit a proposal, which shall be considered by the agency. The Small Business Administration’s Procurement Center Representative concurred with this decision.
